title: Pisces Zodiac Sign: Personality, Love, Career & Compatibility
intro: Pisces (February 19 – March 20) is the dreamy water sign ruled by Neptune and Jupiter. Kind, artistic and intuitive, Pisces feels the world with its whole heart.
personality: Pisces is the most empathetic sign of the zodiac. They sense moods instantly and want everyone around them to feel okay. Creative and imaginative, they often express themselves through music, art or stories. Their sensitivity is a gift, but they need time alone to recharge and clear boundaries to stay strong.
love: Pisces loves like a fairy tale: romantic, devoted and selfless. They need a gentle, honest partner who protects their sensitive heart and shares their dreams.
career: Pisces shines in arts, music, film, healthcare, counseling, charity work, photography and any job where empathy and creativity matter.
friendship: Pisces is the friend who listens for hours, forgives easily and always knows how you really feel.

faq.q: What is the Pisces personality like?
faq.ans: Pisces is compassionate, creative, intuitive and dreamy.

faq.q: Who is Pisces most compatible with?
faq.ans: Pisces tends to match best with Cancer, Scorpio and Taurus.
Pisces is ruled by Neptune, with Jupiter as its traditional ruler.
